purpose: Cross-language agreement on which Ed25519 signatures an Ori verifier accepts under a key ed25519-key-admission/v1 admits, held at the signatures on which the cofactored and cofactorless equations, strict and loose decoding of R, and a reduced or unreduced S disagree.
derivation: rfc8032 are RFC 8032 section 7.1 TEST 1 to 3. Every other admitted key is derived under RFC 8032 section 5.1.5 from seed_hex, SHA-256 of 'ed25519-verification/v1 signer', or from SHA-256 of 'ed25519-verification/v1 other signer'. honest signatures are the first messages 'ed25519-verification/v1 honest message N' whose R has bit 255 clear and set. negated_r flip bit 255 of the nonce point [r]B and sign over the flipped R, at the first messages 'ed25519-verification/v1 negated R N' whose nonce point has bit 255 clear and set. flipped_bit_r flip bit N of the nonce point at the first message 'ed25519-verification/v1 flipped bit N R C' for which the flipped encoding is a canonical point of order L, and sign over the flipped R. torsion_component_r use the nonce SHA-512 of the seed's prefix and the message, reduced modulo L, with torsion_point_hex added to the nonce point. small_order_r and non_canonical_r set S to k*a modulo L, k the full SHA-512 challenge over the given R. s_range alter the S of an honest signature. refused_keys pair a key the admission contract refuses with a signature the cofactorless equation accepts under it.
